Kill a single running agent without affecting the rest of the wave

Cancels the agent via the daemon, marking it as failed. Use 'woco retry &lt;feature-id&gt;' to re-queue it afterwards.

Aliases: `a`

```sh
woco abort <feature-id> [flags]
```

Modifies project state.

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `feature-id` | yes | Feature ID of the agent to abort |

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
